verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a Dashboard page showing total controls, controls with owners, and flags for controls needing attention. Its Compliance Roadmap can filter Unified Controls by framework and group them by Status, which gives an operations lead a per-framework view of passing versus open controls. The Monitors page is also positioned for managing audit readiness. Missing for 10: any documented per-framework readiness percentage or single score, an explicit 'what's left to audit-ready' calculation, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the readiness view is accurate.
